# The How to Live Newsletter

> > A weekly psychology-focused newsletter by Amanda Stern offering mental health resources, philosophical essays, and practical wisdom for living well at any age.

The How to Live Newsletter is Amanda Stern's curated platform combining evidence-based psychology, cultural commentary, and accessible mental health education. The site features comprehensive resource guides, essays on psychological concepts and thinkers, paid workshops on emotional writing, and free mental health toolkits designed for ages 4-94.

## Key Topics

- Mental health resources
- Psychology and philosophy
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
- Trauma and somatic therapy
- Personal development
- Self-improvement
- Maladaptive behaviors
- Cognitive bias
- Cultural wisdom
- Creative writing
- Identity and self-understanding
- Rituals and ceremonies
- Emotional complexity
- Accessibility and support
- Amanda Stern

## Getting Started

- [Home | The How to Live Newsletter](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org): Homepage for Amanda Stern's psychology-focused weekly newsletter
- [Subscribe | The How to Live Newsletter](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/subscribe): Newsletter subscription page featuring Amanda Stern's weekly insights
- [If you need this work but can't pay...](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/twoforone): Information on accessibility and two-for-one subscription model

## Mental Health Resources & Guides

- [The Annual Wildly Comprehensive Mental Health Resource Guide](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/2025guide): Comprehensive mental health resources and toolkits for ages 4-94
- [Free Mental Health Guides](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/resources2024): Free mental health guides and crisis support resources for all ages

## Psychology & Therapeutic Concepts

- [Concepts | The How to Live Newsletter](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/t/concepts): Hub of psychology and philosophy concepts for self-understanding
- [Maladaptive Responses & Behaviors | The How to Live Newsletter](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/t/maladaptive-responses-behaviors): Reference hub on maladaptive behaviors, trauma recovery, and psychology
- [Your Brain Is a Liar. Here's How One Psychiatrist Proved It.](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/aarontemkin): Essay on Aaron Beck and the creation of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
- [Peter Levine and the Trembling Cure: On the Body's Buried Intelligence](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/tremblingcure): Article on trauma therapy and somatic experiencing by Peter Levine

## Essays on Identity & Self-Understanding

- [The Ceremony Is the Cure: What the Rest of the World Knows That We Don't](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/rituals): Essay on cultural wisdom of rituals and ceremonies for life transitions
- [The Unbearable Lightness of Not Being Yourself](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/breakyourself): Personal essay on breaking habits and identity transformation
- [The Invention of Self-Doubt](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/selfdoubt-fb91): Article exploring self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and childhood development
- [Proust's First Selfie](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/proust): Essay on Proust Questionnaire, confession albums, and identity performance
- [There's a Name for the Texture of Being You](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/qualia): Essay on qualia, kinesthetic realism, and emotion vs feeling
- [Ntozake Shange Refused to Pathologize Herself. Here's What She Did Instead.](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/p/ntozke): Essay on Ntozake Shange, mental illness, and artistic form

## Workshops & Learning

- [How to Write Complex Emotion - Only 12 spaces! | The How to Live Newsletter](https://www.thehowtolivenewsletter.org/products/complexemotion): Paid workshop on writing complex emotion and craft techniques
